# PromptBase

> > The #1 marketplace for buying, selling, and discovering AI prompts across ChatGPT, Midjourney, Gemini, and other leading AI platforms.

PromptBase is a comprehensive prompt marketplace featuring over 260,000 AI prompts and custom generator apps. The platform serves creators, businesses, and developers seeking high-quality prompts for image generation, content creation, marketing automation, and specialized applications across multiple AI models including Midjourney, GPT, Gemini Image, Leonardo AI, and Veo.

## Marketplace & Core Platform

- [AI Prompts Marketplace](https://promptbase.com/): Homepage: marketplace with 260,000+ prompts for ChatGPT, Midjourney, Gemini
- [Free AI Prompts](https://promptbase.com/free-prompts): Collection of 3,000+ free AI prompts for art, writing, and video creation

## Business & Marketing Apps

- [Custom Marketing Plan Generator](https://promptbase.com/app/custom-marketing-plan-generator): AI app generating actionable marketing strategies for small businesses

## Developer & Technical Apps

- [AI Scalability Solutions Generator](https://promptbase.com/app/ai-scalability-solutions): AI platform app for cognitive task integration and scalability solutions
- [Secure Login System Generator](https://promptbase.com/app/develop-secure-login-system): Generator app for secure login systems with authentication features
